# Scorching Ray (`spells:scorching-ray`)
**Level 2 [Evocation](../magic-schools/evocation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** 120 feet
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)
**Attack:** ranged | **Damage Type:** [Fire](../damage-types/fire.md)

You hurl three fiery rays. You can hurl them at one target within range or at several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2.

| Slot Level | Damage |
|---|---|
| 2 | 2d6 |
